post.description: The owner is the organization the request acts for — any organization, never assumed to be a union (ADR-056 § 5). post.description: Reserves each line’s quantity of its stock item for the holder — reserved grows, on hand does not — and records a RESERVE movement and STOCK_RESERVED per line. All or nothing: a line short of available stock reserves none (422 `INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_STOCK`); lines of two warehouses are 422 `LINES_SPAN_WAREHOUSES`; an `expiresAt` not in the future or past the longest reservation allowed is 422 `EXPIRY_OUT_OF_RANGE`; a holder other than the owner is 422 `HOLDER_NOT_OWNER` (Q-104). A stock item of another organization is 404. Under any number of concurrent requests the stock is never over-reserved: available never falls below zero. One transaction (ADR-056 § 3): the stock items the command touches are locked in ascending id order, reservations of theirs past `expiresAt` are released first, then the balance, its append-only movement and the event commit together — or nothing does. Anything of another organization, and anything that does not exist, is 404, never 403 (S-03). AUDITOR, SYSTEM_ADMIN and service tokens are refused (403).

401.description: No credentials, or a token that is expired, unverifiable or issued for another audience.

403.description: Authenticated, but not permitted: no role of INVENTORY_OPERATOR_ROLES (commands) or INVENTORY_READER_ROLES / INVENTORY_OPERATOR_ROLES (reads) in the organization the request acts for (INSUFFICIENT_ROLE); acting for an organization the caller is not a member of (TENANT_MISMATCH); the oversight role, the platform administrator, a service token, or a user token without the platform user id on a command (FORBIDDEN); on create, a body naming another organization (FORBIDDEN).

404.description: Not found — also returned for a warehouse, stock item or reservation of another organization, so its existence is never disclosed.

get.summary: Read one stock item and its balance

post.description: Adds `quantity` to on hand of the product in the warehouse, creating the stock item on its first receipt, and records a RECEIPT movement and STOCK_RECEIVED. A warehouse of another organization is 404. A balance past the largest quantity stored is 422 `QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE`. One transaction (ADR-056 § 3): the stock items the command touches are locked in ascending id order, reservations of theirs past `expiresAt` are released first, then the balance, its append-only movement and the event commit together — or nothing does. A stock item another command holds longer than INVENTORY_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS is 409 CONFLICT with Retry-After; retry with the same key. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` (docs/06 § 6.8): without one, or with one outside 8 to 255 characters, 400 VALIDATION_FAILED and nothing is done. The same key with the same body from the same user answers the original response and does nothing again; the same key with another body or user is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate that arrives while the first is still being processed waits for its answer and past a few seconds is 409 CONFLICT with Retry-After. The caller must be a signed-in person with a platform user id and a role of INVENTORY_OPERATOR_ROLES (ORGANIZATION_ADMIN by default, Q-103) in the organization the request acts for; AUDITOR, SYSTEM_ADMIN and service tokens are refused (403). Anything of another organization is 404, never 403. Refusals carry their closed reason in `details[].code` (docs/06 § 6.7).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required, 8 to 255 characters. The same key with the same body from the same user returns the first response and does nothing again; with a different body or user, 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; while the first request is still in flight, 409 CONFLICT with Retry-After. Scoped to the organization, kept for INVENTORY_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HOURS (24 by default) — and, for a stock command, applied at most once per stock item for good.

409.description: An Idempotency-Key reused with a different request or user, or one that already applied this command to the stock item (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED); the same key still in flight, or a stock item another request held past INVENTORY_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS (CONFLICT, with Retry-After — retry with the same key); `expectedVersion` that is not the current version (OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_FAILED); a reservation that is no longer ACTIVE (INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, RESERVATION_NOT_ACTIVE).

Retry-After.description: Sent only with CONFLICT — this Idempotency-Key is still being processed, or a stock item another request holds was not released within INVENTORY_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS: the seconds to wait before retrying with the same key. Absent on every other 409.

422.description: Well-formed but refused by a rule (BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION): not enough available stock (INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_STOCK — all or nothing), on hand below what is reserved (ON_HAND_WOULD_BE_NEGATIVE), a balance past the largest quantity stored (QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE), lines of two warehouses (LINES_SPAN_WAREHOUSES), an expiresAt out of range (EXPIRY_OUT_OF_RANGE), a holder other than the owner (HOLDER_NOT_OWNER, Q-104). When refused for a closed reason, `details` names it: one entry, `path` the area (stock, reservation) and `code` the reason, one of those listed here. Branch on `code` and `details[].code`, never on `message`. (stock: ON_HAND_WOULD_BE_NEGATIVE, QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE)

info.title: Rasta — Inventory Service
info.description: Inventory and forward logistics (COM-006, ADR-056). Warehouses — of any organization, never assumed to be a union — and, per product and warehouse, a stock item whose balance (on hand, reserved, available = on hand − reserved) changes only through an append-only ledger of movements: RECEIPT, ADJUSTMENT, and the RESERVE / RELEASE / ISSUE of reservations. Every command is one transaction that locks the stock items it touches in ascending id order (PostgreSQL row locks, no Redis — ADR-056 § 4), so the balance, its movement and its event commit together; the database refuses a negative or over-reserved balance and any balance that does not equal the sum of its movements. Everything is the warehouse owner’s: another organization gets 404. Every command requires an Idempotency-Key. Products, orders and purchase orders are opaque references to the services that own them (Q-105); quantities are whole numbers of a product’s base unit. Shipments and tracking follow.
